Aisha: handing off to @Max — quick notes before I go offline:
Aisha: - Canary deploy 3.2.1 started 2024-03-15T11:30Z (deploy-3.2.1-canary-17). p50 auth-latency +10ms vs baseline. Not critical, but watch p50 and error rate.
Aisha: - KV eviction change rolled to staging earlier; eviction-count metric may spike, affects cold starts for small customers.
Aisha: - Prefetch TTL lowered to 6h in prod; expect slightly more cold starts on low-traffic keys.
Aisha: Dashboards: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ABC/infra?orgId=1
Aisha: If you need quick metric check:
Aisha: ```bash
curl -s 'https://metrics.redwood.internal/api/v1/query?query=rate(auth_latency_p50[5m])'
curl -s 'https://metrics.redwood.internal/api/v1/query?query=rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])'
```
Max: Thanks — taking over. I'll watch latency and set a temporary alert: error_rate > 0.5% for 5m.
Devon: FYI I merged the batching-config PR (https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/402). It reduces batch-window to 8ms for low-concurrency tiers — could affect tail latency.
Max: Noted. I'll keep an eye on tail (p95/p99) and revert if we see regressions.
oncall-bot: SRE Rotation: Max is now oncall (8h). :bell:
Aisha: Action items for Max: 1) monitor auth p50/p95 for next 2h; 2) watch kv_evictions_total and cold_start_rate; 3) escalate to eng-runtime if p95 increases >15% (pager if during business hours).
Max: Got it. I'll post in 30m with status. :thumbsup:
Devon: Ping me if you want me to roll back batching-config, happy to do a quick revert.
Aisha: Thanks team — leaving notes in the oncall doc as well: https://docs.redwood.internal/oncall/2024-03-15-crossshift
Max: taking over — switching to bridge if signs show. :eyes:
